To maximize $|S|$, we need to minimize both the number of edges $|E|$ and the number of pairs at distance $>2$.

For a connected graph, $|E| \ge n-1$. The minimum value $|E|=n-1$ occurs only for trees. Among trees, the distance between any two vertices is at most 2 only if the tree is a star graph $K_{1, n-1}$. In a star graph, there are $n-1$ pairs at distance 1 and $\binom{n-1}{2}$ pairs at distance 2. All other pairs are at distance 1 or 2, so there are no pairs at distance $>2$.
